nodes.html: The Penumbra Artist Series brings to life the work of featured photographers and other notable guest artists and scholars, offering a unique opportunity to engage with them in an intimate setting as they discuss their work and process.

All lectures are In-Person only, and are free to attend. We ask that you kindly RSVP.

Any changes to the program will be announced online. All lectures and other events are held at Penumbra Foundation at 7pm.

36 E. 30th St. New York, NY, 10016 (between Madison Ave. & Park Ave. South
